name: Sky-T1-32B-Flash
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from NovaSky-AI/Sky-T1-32B-Preview (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from NovaSky-AI/Sky-T1-32B-Preview: 64 full GQA layers (kv heads 8, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. SimPO (10K preference pairs, lr 5e-7, beta 2.0) on top of NovaSky-AI/Sky-T1-32B-Preview, same 32.76B Qwen2.5-32B config. Recorded for one strict accuracy win, LCB Easy 89.0 vs 87.4, and a tie at Math500 88.6 and AIME24 43.3 - while LCB Medium slips 56.3 vs 56.8. Its actual claim is efficiency: -33% to -57% average generation length at equal accuracy. Note the card ALSO lists Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct as a base_model tag; the comparison table's predecessor column is Sky-T1-32B-Preview, which is what this record is based on.
